definitions.ask: Also chip links under closed entries and in past daily notes, not just today's open Pomodoros?
definitions.why: The clock belongs to the task, like the #off tag it stands in for; home chips mark history too.

definitions.ask: Also put the chip after prose task links (the ones wearing a status ring), not only ledger rows?
definitions.why: The clock only decides Pomodoro sessions; chips across every love-note link would be noise.
